name: cursor-image-trail
title: Cursor Image Trail
description: Drops a pool of images or cards along the pointer's path inside an area, larger and longer-lived the faster you move.

props.name: items
props.description: What the trail drops, in turn: images, cards, anything that fits a square.

props.name: children
props.description: The area the trail follows the pointer across.

props.name: distance
props.description: Pixels the pointer travels before the next item drops.

props.name: itemSize
props.description: Width and height of each dropped item in pixels.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds an item stays before it has fully faded.

props.name: velocityScale
props.description: How much pointer speed enlarges and lengthens an item, from 0 to 1.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the trail off. It is also off on touch devices and under reduced motion.
